archetypes.name: state-flow
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes /design gate sequencing, automatic review looping, sentinels, and cap behavior beyond the static panel's generic coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the /design Step 3, Gate B, Step 3b, and Gate C control flow introduced by the heuristic multi-round continuation change. Check whether counters, LOOP_STATUS branches, sentinels, pause/resume idempotency, degraded-panel paths, panel failures, and cap-reached paths remain coherent. Pay attention to whether in-memory variables from Step 3 are reliably available when Gate B evaluates the continuation heuristic and whether the described re-invocation can safely re-enter the Step 3 branch matrix. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-awk
archetypes.rationale: The renderer fix depends on subtle awk block parsing and shell harness fixtures that merit focused review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the render-final-summary.sh Plan review counting logic and its new regression tests. Check awk matching of FINDING and OOS headers, Focus area bucketing, fallback low-bucket behavior, file-boundary handling, and whether malformed or empty artifacts produce the intended summary line. Also inspect whether the shell tests are deterministic and actually fail on the previous broken regex. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: The change spans SKILL.md, approval-gates.md, harness docs, and structure pins, so cross-surface contract drift is a key risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the behavioral contract stated across skills/design/SKILL.md, skills/design/references/approval-gates.md, scripts/test-design-structure.sh, and related markdown updates. Look for stale wording, missing harness pins, contradictions around the unified cap, and mismatches between documented Gate C manual rerun semantics and the new automatic rerun heuristic. Consider whether Part A, Part B, and Part C from the plan are all represented without creating new ambiguous operator prompts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
